_comment: Held-out evaluation subset (15 of 52, stratified across tiers, regulations, compliant controls and near-miss cases). These cases NEVER feed calibration-rule distillation — the lesson proposer excludes them automatically — so configuration D (calibration) results reported on this subset measure transfer, not memorisation. Change this list only by adding newly created cases; moving an existing case out of the held-out set after rules have been distilled invalidates the split.
